values.AssociatedLNGNotes: A S&P Global Platts report from October 2021, carried by Hellenic Shipping News, says Gulf South's 30-inch main line from the Goodrich compressor station, northeast of Houston, to South Texas feeds gas to Freeport LNG. A planned outage on that segment cut its capacity and forced Freeport LNG to reduce its loadings.

verifications.note: A repost of a S&P Global Platts report dated October 2021. It names Gulf South and its main 30-inch line feeding Freeport LNG, and says the outage forced Freeport LNG to cut loadings.

records.researcher_notes: The flag rests on one maintenance story. It says a section of the Gulf South main line feeds Freeport LNG, which is an export terminal. The tie is to that section, not the whole 7,140 mile system. The story is a repost, so confidence is medium. A 2014 article describes a new Gulf South header built to serve Freeport LNG, but its archived copy would not load, so it is not cited. Texas Gateway, a 2029 Boardwalk project from the Carthage Header to Louisiana aimed at LNG markets, is a separate project and is not on this row.

ledger.note: Searched for an LNG link to the Great Lakes security loops and the 1998 expansion. None was found. The filings describe reliability and Midwest deliveries.
Searched for an LNG link to the Great Lakes 1998 expansion and its 1997 loop filing. None was found.

Searched the Greater Philadelphia Expansion. Sources describe it as Marcellus gas supply to the Philadelphia region. The LNG export proposals at Chester and Gibbstown are separate projects, and no source ties this line to them.

Searched the Guardian G3 expansion and the DT Midstream fact sheet. The fact sheet names five local distribution companies and Midwest demand. The LNG talk on DT Midstream calls concerns its Haynesville system, not this line.
Searched the Guardian mainline. No LNG tie was found. The LNG talk on DT Midstream calls concerns its Haynesville system, not this line.

Searched the Gulf Crossing pipeline twice. It carries Barnett and Woodford gas from Sherman, Texas to Perryville, Louisiana, and interconnects with Gulf South. No source names an LNG terminal it serves.
Searched the Gulf South system and its Louisiana, Mississippi and Alabama expansions for an LNG link. None was found.
Searched the Carthage to Keatchie loop. No LNG link was found. Texas Gateway starts at the Carthage Header, but it is a separate 2029 project and does not tie this 2006 loop.
Searched the Gulf South system and its Alabama expansions for an LNG link. None was found.
Searched the Gulf South Southeast Expansion and related Mississippi and Alabama projects. No LNG link was found.
Searched the Gulf South Texas to Mississippi Expansion. No LNG link was found. The South Mississippi Project in the EIA list is a different Energy Transfer line.
Searched the Lamar County Expansion. It adds delivery to a Cooperative Energy power plant. No LNG link was found.
A news report from October 2021 says a section of the Gulf South main line feeds Freeport LNG, and a maintenance outage on it cut Freeport loadings. Flagged yes with Freeport LNG Terminal.
Searched the McComb compressor station project. It is a station replacement with no LNG link found.
Searched the Mobile Compressor Expansion and the Gulf South Mobile area. No LNG link was found.
Searched the Southeast Market Expansion. No LNG link was found.

Searched Gulf Xpress. An RBN Energy article from 2019 says it delivers gas to Mississippi, Louisiana and other Gulf Coast markets. It names no LNG terminal, and the LNG talk in that article concerns other flows.
Searched the Gulfstream main line. The Port Dolphin pipe that delivers regasified LNG into Gulfstream is a separate 3.93 mile line, and no export tie was found.
Searched the Gulfstream Phase IV Bartow lateral. It serves the Bartow power plant, and no LNG link was found.
Searched the Gulfstream Phase VI expansion. It raised operating pressure to serve the Big Bend power plant. No LNG link was found.
